reviews.author: Aubrie Law
reviews.text: Soooo much fun! My family and I love it here, its our 2nd time coming. Great views, boat launch, swimming are for the kids and a nice playground.  They have bathrooms where you can also take a hot shower. Nice for taking a bike ride as well. The views out on the water are beautiful. Definitely coming back again next summer.

reviews.author: E. B.
reviews.text: Beautiful park. Great camping facilities. This is a super place to come with the family. Nice playground for the little ones. Good boat ramp. Good place to just sit and look out on the reservoir. People who live closer by should be taking advantage of this place. Perfect spot to work remotely if you're looking for a space away from your space. Great option for picnics.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Cashdollar
reviews.text: Great state park with more amenities than most RV parks. The bike trail is amazing.

reviews.author: Tara H
reviews.text:
We stayed at spot 73 in our glamper over the weekend (05/30/25 - 06/01/25). This park is by far the cleanest and most gorgeous one yet! The campsite is big and feels very private. Our site had water and electric hookups. There is a dump station by the ranger station. We did have to wait in line to dump during checkout time, so just be mentally prepared for that.
There is a paved trail that connects to the Apple Capital Loop Trail but we didn't explore it. It was our 1st trip here so we did some sightseeing and even drove to Leavenworth for dinner!
We loved the little store where we got milkshakes and Italian soda. They did have a very small selection of supplies that you might have forgotten to bring. Sunscreen, razor, fish bait, snacks.  The water was cold but worth dipping your toes in! We didn't rent boats but it was awesome knowing we could if we wanted to.
We stopped by the lookout where you can see Lincoln's facial profile and it amazingly looks like President Lincoln! We enjoyed this park and will have to come back.

reviews.author: Chancee Wilkinson
reviews.text: We spent the night here and it was a lovely surprise. As we drove into town I was not excited about how hot it was and the major lack of trees. We turned down the road to the state park and were greeted by many large trees and green grassy fielded. We were in site 31 and it was so nice. We have a 42ft 5th wheel and tow truck. The spot was plenty big for us and no issues getting in, out and driving around the park. There are big shade trees all around and loads of space between site. The river was fun to play in, it’s the perfect depth for little kids. There is a park and play set for the kids that is pretty fun. It overall is a very nice state park and a breath of fresh air with all the green and shade in the middle of all the hot dry heat.

reviews.author: JayneNC
reviews.text: This is a beautiful well kept campground with cabins for rent too. Many families make it a tradition to come here every year. For boating the river can't be beat and there is a launch and mooring. You can get a good idea of options on the website. Our kids are teens and we have come here since they were toddlers. Lots of grass for camp games, big fields for soccer, tennis courts, a nice playground and pathways for biking for all ages. Plus lots of sun!
reviews.title: One of the finest state parks anywhere.

reviews.author: Diane B
reviews.text: Lincoln Rock Stat Park is large and offers numerous amenities including tent and RV camping, cabins, a swimming beach and a park store. Spaces are far enough apart to ensure quiet. Bathrooms are clean and well maintained. We chose one of the four original cabins. It was clean, nestled among the trees, close to bathrooms and spaced far enough apart for privacy. While it does not have the self contained bathroom or small kitchen space that the newer cabins have, it does have electricity and a separate bedroom. The newer cabins are located on what appears to be a hot rock and in 90 degree weather, the lower cost and cool location of the older cabins seemed a very fair trade off! A very enjoyable experience.
reviews.title: Boat Camping

reviews.author: LisaL131
reviews.text: Well in our top 5 anyway...and that's saying something because we camp a lot. Our campsite was huge and faced the Columbia River. Even though it was Memorial Day weekend and the campsite was full, it did not seem crowded. My boys loved jumping into the freezing Columbia River, riding their bikes around camp, playing soccer on the soccer field complete with goals and playing in camp. Wenatchee is such a cute town to explore as well. And we even snuck up to Chelan for a half day to explore things up there. Great location and super campground!
reviews.title: Best camping trip ever

reviews.author: valerie b
reviews.text: I good place to camp at if your are going to go up to the Grand Coulee Dam to watch the laser light show.
reviews.title: Nice place to camp.

reviews.author: Briarmoon
reviews.text: This campground is a giant park and a kid's dream. Located on the river it has a beautiful view. It can be incredibly windy though! It was surprising how windy it got every day. Beautiful location for the Apple Blossom Festival.
reviews.title: Park turned campground

reviews.author: Jimmarker
reviews.text: Nice family area right on the Columbia River. Very well maintained. Lake formed by the Rocky Reach Dam. Jet ski rental also available. Nice view of the mountains on the west side of river area/city of Entiat.

reviews.author: Robert R
reviews.text: We come to Lincoln Rock every year. It is one of the best, if not the best state park in washington. The spaces are large and spaced well apart. There is also several large areas with volleyball nets for things to do. All the sites have grass that is well maintained as well as the play areas.

reviews.author: Roy S
reviews.text: We booked a site along the Columbia River for one night on our trip south. Wow! I never expected such a clean well organized and laid out park. Loved the pull through running parallel with the river and total privacy for our site. Bathrooms were spotless, playing fields for sports were manicured The only downside was that as Canadians we had to pay a $5 non resident fee bringing our site cost up to $65.00 us. Gulp.
reviews.title: Great camping

reviews.author: NRHSCH
reviews.text: We have been going to Lincoln Rock State Park for about 5 yrs now! First started camping with friends who had 5 kids from 5-16! Absolutely loved it! Clean amenities and close to home so that if anyone had to work they would commute to and from! Great swimming area also! Great time to be had for young and old alike!

reviews.author: 749gaylet
reviews.text: We camp at Lincoln Rock State Park every Mother's day weekend. Always have a big BBQ the Saturday before Mother's day and visit with our big family. Lots of squirrels, groundhogs and the occasional deer in the park. If you bicycle, bring them. It connects to the Loop Trail that is paved and you can ride over 25 miles. Plenty to do. Nice playground for the kids, play soccer, boating, skiing and fishing also. Nice clean park.

reviews.author: PaulaBow
reviews.text: We love to stop here and do so at least once a year. Whatever you are looking for in a state park, they have it; beautiful setting, large sites, large beach, miles of paths for hiking and biking and one of the nicest boat ramps we have seen (and with moorage available). On the down side, summer weekends are hard to find spots. The group camp is really nice too.

reviews.author: Paradise793002
reviews.text: what a wonderful state park! next to the Columbia River with beautiful views. spaces are kept clean. the restrooms are clean as well as the showers. close to Wenatchee City for any supplies, restaurants, etc. that you like or need. the park is named for the silhouette of president Lincoln. there is a boat launch and swimming area. the spaces are large and flat. close to fruit farms and Leavenworth- a very fun village to visit any time of the year. the leaves were changing, giving all the more grander of the area.. didn't want to leave!

reviews.author: kentnmary18
reviews.text: Beautiful spot on Columbia River. Camp in tent and/or w RV. Nice small beach for kids swimming. Excellent for boaters. Grassy areas and sprinklers come on every day.....😕. We zipped tent and were good. Makes a bit of mess but dries up quickly in summer sun. Store on site with reasonable prices. Ice cream, hot dogs, burgers, ice, wood, candy and coffee drinks. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: maryk99218
reviews.text: We took part in the annual rally for T@B teardrop campers at Lincoln State Park recently and found the park to be a great place for gatherings. Spacious campsites, clean restrooms with hot showers, shelters for group gatherings. Large expanses of green lawn, surrounded by dramatic dry mountains. Friendly and helpful campground hosts and rangers. Located mid-Washington State on the Columbia River.

reviews.author: Janet B
reviews.text: We were in site 83 and our tent trailer got filled with some type of bug that sent us home early. We were parked under a pine tree and they were dropping out of the tree and big in our trailer and produced rapidly . We tried bombing it but there are still some live ones. Will bomb it again and see how many more die. I don't think we'll ever go back there.
reviews.title: Infestation of bugs in our trailer
